

// package main






trait Empty<'a, T> {}





trait Reader<'a, T: Clone + 'a> {


fn read(value: &'a T) -> (&'a T);





fn clone_value(value: &'a T) -> (T);


}







trait Plain {


fn value() -> (u8);


}



fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let _: Option<&dyn Empty<'static, u8>> = None;



    
}
